recommendation: Keep the source fix. It updates the only build-scope stale surface found while preserving the already-correct ServiceRequest source and avoiding out-of-scope retired or historical artifacts.
issue_request: FHIR-7134 was Published/Persuasive with Modification for DSTU1 and requested DiagnosticOrder.clinicalNotes be renamed/replaced by DiagnosticOrder.reason 0..* CodeableConcept, the diagnosticorder-reason extension be removed, and DiagnosticOrder.note 0..* Annotation be added.
initial_application: Commit a7b323be06ccbe636b8b9f0ec4fbb6ac384298f0 explicitly pre-applied #7134 together with #7135 and #7684 by changing DiagnosticOrder examples and spreadsheet rows from clinicalNotes to reason and adding DiagnosticOrder.note. Later migrations renamed DiagnosticOrder to DiagnosticRequest and then merged it into ProcedureRequest/ServiceRequest.
additional_context: ServiceRequest is the active current resource in source/fhir.ini, and DiagnosticOrder is marked as subsumed into ServiceRequest. Current ServiceRequest.reason and ServiceRequest.note already carry the seed semantics. The diagnosticorder-reason extension appears only in tools/history release artifacts, and the remaining source/profiles/cda.profile.xml DiagnosticOrder.clinicalNotes mention is out of build scope because fhir.ini comments out the CDA profile. The Library QUICK model-info XML is active build input through publish.ini and the Library examples list/header, and it still had the stale clinicalNotes field.
reconciliation: Changed source/library/library-quick-model-definition-content.xml so QUICK.DiagnosticOrder replaces clinicalNotes with reason as list<System.Concept> and adds note as list<System.String>, matching the simplified QUICK representation of the FHIR-7134 reason/note split. No retired DiagnosticOrder/DiagnosticRequest source, historical release artifact, or out-of-build CDA profile file was edited.
source_changes: source/library/library-quick-model-definition-content.xml: replaced QUICK.DiagnosticOrder.clinicalNotes with reason list<System.Concept> and added note list<System.String>.
